correctness.rationale: Theorem 1.3 of González-Riquelme–Oliveira e Silva supplies the exact 1+1/p-1/p² sixth-power constant and necessity of constant modulus. On each generic triple-convolution fiber, equality of same-sum/sum-of-squares products gives R_m(u)R_m(v)=R_m(u+v), with Q(u,v)=u²+uv+v²≠0. For p≡2 mod3 all nonzero pairs are generic; for p≡1 mod3 the supplied bridge excludes precisely the isotropic slopes and exists even at p=7 (excluded set has five distinct elements). Thus each R_m is a character. The resulting recurrence d(m−2)d(m+1)=d(m−1)d(m) makes the multiplicative second difference 2-periodic, hence constant for odd prime p. Periodic product constraints force p-th roots of unity, so rho is quadratic; conversely quadratic modulation translates physical coordinates. Distinct polynomial pairs are distinct because degree two <p. The finite rank tests p=5,...,31 check, but do not prove, the universal theorem.
